name: GCP VPC and Network Security Assessment
description: Security assessment of GCP networking configurations. Covers VPC networks, firewall rules, Shared VPC, VPC Service Controls, Cloud NAT, Cloud Armor, Private Google Access, and network segmentation within GCP environments.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to GCP VPC and network security assessment

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands GCP VPC architecture and network security primitives
evidence: Can explain VPC networks, subnets, firewall rules, and routes
Understands the difference between VPC firewall rules and Cloud Armor policies
Familiar with VPC flow logs and their use in security monitoring

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Reviews GCP network configurations under supervision using established tooling
evidence: Enumerates VPC configurations and firewall rules with guidance
Identifies overly permissive firewall rules using lab checklists
Documents network security findings with supervision

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently assesses GCP network architecture and segmentation
evidence: Independently reviews network segmentation across Shared VPC and peered networks
Identifies lateral movement risks through firewall rule gaps and network misconfigurations
Evaluates VPC Service Controls for data exfiltration prevention effectiveness

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Handles complex multi-project network assessments; develops automated network analysis tooling
evidence: Assesses complex Shared VPC and multi-project network architectures
Develops tooling for automated firewall rule and network path analysis
Reviews network assessment work of junior analysts
Evaluates hybrid connectivity (Cloud Interconnect, Cloud VPN) security

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines lab GCP network assessment methodology; publishes network security research
evidence: Designed or maintains the lab's GCP network security assessment framework
Published research on GCP network security bypass or VPC Service Controls evasion
Trains teams on advanced GCP network security assessment
Recognized as authority on GCP network architecture security

assessment_methods.description: Assess a multi-project GCP environment and identify all network segmentation weaknesses and lateral movement paths
Review network security findings and architecture diagrams from recent GCP assessments

cis: CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v4.0.0 - Section 3 Networking
